en.headline: Free medical services for Wang Fuk Court fire victims extended to end of April 2027
en.dek: The Health Bureau said Chinese and Western medicine outreaches, free dental dentures and Hospital Authority fee waivers will continue for another four months after the original year-end deadline.
body: The Health Bureau announced on Monday that free medical arrangements for residents affected by the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po would be extended by four months to 30 April 2027.

The measures cover free Chinese and Western medicine outpatient services, free fitting of dental dentures, and full medical fee waivers at the Hospital Authority. All 79 people injured in the fire and treated in public hospitals have recovered and been discharged.

As of 30 October, district health centre hotlines had received 641 calls related to the fire, with 266 referrals processed, while the Hospital Authority had provided free services to about 2,500 affected residents. Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau thanked medical staff and private-sector practitioners for their continued support, noting that outreaches had already been extended three times.

zh.headline: 宏福苑火災受影響居民免費醫療安排延長至明年4月底
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局宣布，中西醫義診、牙醫免費鑲配假牙及醫管局全額醫療費用豁免由原定年底延長四個月至2027年4月30日。
body: 醫務衞生局周一宣布，為受大埔宏福苑火災影響居民提供的免費中西醫義診、牙醫免費鑲配假牙服務，以及醫管局全額醫療費用豁免，將由原定今年12月底延長四個月至明年4月30日。
火災中送往公立醫院接受治療的79名傷者已全部康復出院。截至10月30日，十八區康健中心熱線累計接獲641人次與火災相關來電，已處理266宗轉介；醫管局已為約2500名受影響居民免費提供所需醫療服務。
醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂感謝醫管局醫護人員及參與義診的私營醫護，指公私營醫療界別過去一年持續支援，義診服務已先後三次延長。
